scenes.say: Pecan, pumpkin, or apple? Ranking Thanksgiving pies from most sugar to least.
scenes.headline: WHICH PIE WINS?
scenes.sub: Ranked from most sugar to least

scenes.say: Number three. Pecan pie. Corn syrup and sugar make it the sweetest slice.
scenes.headline: PECAN PIE

scenes.say: Per hundred grams, pecan has about fifty two grams of carbs. Pumpkin, about thirty five.
scenes.headline: THE CARB GAP

scenes.say: Number two. Pumpkin pie. Fewer carbs than pecan, plus protein from eggs and milk.
scenes.headline: PUMPKIN PIE

scenes.say: But here's the surprise. The winner isn't the one most people guess.
scenes.headline: BUT WAIT...

scenes.say: Number one. Apple pie. Carbs about the same as pumpkin, but usually the least sugar.
scenes.headline: APPLE PIE

scenes.say: Whatever you pick, keep the slice small, have it after your meal, and go easy on toppings.
scenes.headline: ENJOY IT SMARTER

scenes.say: A small slice of apple pie, after dinner. That's the winning Thanksgiving move.
scenes.headline: THE WINNING SLICE
